blocks.title: Calculate Kenya car import duty, CRSP and cargo tax before you ship
blocks.body: Use this Kenya import duty calculator to estimate vehicle duty, car import tax, CRSP-based customs value, and general cargo duty before committing to a shipment. The vehicle tab is best for imported cars; the cargo tab is best for commercial goods; the CRSP tab helps when you need to work backwards from a customs value.
paragraphs: Have a customs value? Work backwards to find the original CRSP. Then use that CRSP in the Vehicle Import tab to calculate taxes for similar vehicles of different ages.
Share your cargo details for an accurate duty assessment
items: For cars: estimate import duty, excise, VAT, IDF and RDL from CRSP, age and engine size.
For cargo: estimate customs duty and statutory charges from CIF value and duty category.
For KRA review: use the result as a planning estimate, then confirm with actual documents before shipment or clearance.

blocks.title: Estimate car duty, cargo duty and CRSP-based charges in one place
blocks.body: Importers often need to compare vehicle duty, general cargo duty and CRSP-based customs values before deciding whether a shipment makes commercial sense. This calculator separates vehicle and cargo estimates while keeping the full tax picture easy to review.
paragraphs: Use the vehicle tab for CRSP value, engine size, age/depreciation, import duty, excise, VAT, IDF and RDL estimates.
Use the cargo tab for CIF-based import duty planning where the HS code, cargo type and customs value drive the estimate.
Use the CRSP finder when you need to work backwards from a depreciated customs value to an indicative original CRSP.

faq.question: Is this a KRA car import duty calculator?
faq.answer: This calculator gives an indicative Kenya vehicle import duty estimate using CRSP value, vehicle age, engine size, import duty, excise duty, VAT, IDF and RDL. Actual KRA assessment may vary depending on the file and current directives.

faq.question: Can I calculate cargo import duty in Kenya?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the cargo tab to estimate import duty, VAT, IDF and RDL from the CIF value and duty category. HS code classification and agency requirements can change the final assessment.

faq.question: What is CRSP in Kenya vehicle duty calculation?
faq.answer: CRSP is the Current Retail Selling Price used as a reference value in Kenya vehicle duty assessment. The vehicle tab helps estimate taxes from CRSP and depreciation, while the CRSP finder helps work backwards from a customs value.
